newsitem.title: USA: Cherry sees lower Q4 results than in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Cherry sees lower Q4 results than in Q3.

text.p: Cherry Corp, reporting record November 30 third-quarter results, said it anticipates lower sales and earnings in the fourth quarter ending February 28.
It cited customer plant shutdowns over the holiday season and seasonally lower keyboard sales.
For the third quarter, the company posted earnings of $0.58 per share, up from $0.26 a year earlier. Sales advanced to $116.7 million from $107.2 million.
Cherry manufactures electronic switches, sensors and keyboards and displays and semiconductors for the worldwide automotive, computer and consumer and commercial markets.
